string.text: Hire By Hero Class
Hire and upgrade troops along paths compatible with the adopted hero's class.
No compatible troop path could be found for this hero class.
No class-compatible upgrade path remains.
Enable Random Events
Master switch for all random campaign events. Disable this to prevent any new random events from starting.
Enable Cursed Artifact
Allow the automatic cursed-artifact campaign event.
Daily Trigger Chance %
Chance rolled once per campaign day when no curse is active and cooldown has elapsed.
Cooldown Days
Minimum campaign days between successful curse triggers.
Required Battle Wins
Qualifying campaign victories the cursed hero must personally participate in.
Outgoing Damage Penalty %
Percentage less damage dealt by the cursed hero.
Incoming Damage Increase %
Percentage additional damage received by the cursed hero.
Artifact Weapon Bonus
Fixed bounded damage, speed, and missile-speed modifier for Cursed Legacy weapons.
Diagnostic Logging
Log trigger rolls and rejected or duplicate battle callbacks.
Allow the automatic Immortal Encounter campaign event.
Chance rolled once per eligible campaign day.
Minimum campaign days between successfully constructed encounters.
Minimum Player Level
Minimum main-hero level required.
Army Strength %
Enemy troop count relative to the player's current party strength.
Participant Gold Reward
BLT gold awarded once to each adopted hero who fought on the player's side in a victory.
Immortal Name
Display name of the temporary challenger.
Cult Name
Display name of the temporary challenger clan.
Log trigger rolls, eligibility failures, and lifecycle transitions.
Allow the automatic Priest's Crusade campaign event.
Minimum campaign days after a successful crusade creation before another may occur.
Minimum Kingdom Tier
Minimum tier of the player's clan while it belongs to a kingdom.
Crusader troop count relative to target kingdom strength, clamped to 100-1000.
Priest Name
Display name of the crusader leader.
Crusader Clan Name
Display name of the persistent independent crusader clan.
